messages:
hana: heads-up: nightly doc build failed with a couple of broken fragments from the configuration guide. linkcheck flagged headings inside admonitions that don't get slugs when a fenced codeblock immediately follows the bullet.

lee: can you paste the CI output? i haven't seen this one before.

hana: sure — from CI:```
Linkcheck: Broken fragment(s):
 - /guides/configuration.md -> #using-custom-kernels (generated: none)
 - /guides/configuration.md -> #advanced-caching (generated: #advancedcaching)
```

phil: that's weird. I think Docusaurus treats the admonition content differently; if a heading is the last child before a fenced codeblock the heading node can be swallowed by the parser and the slug isn't emitted. MkDocs/Material handled it fine which is why we missed it locally.

lee: reproduction steps? i can try locally with the same mdx-loader version.

hana: minimal repro: an admonition block with a bullet list, then an h3, then a ```yaml block. On docusaurus build the h3 doesn't get an id. Quick workaround is to add an explicit HTML id or insert a blank HTML comment line between heading and code block.

phil: better fix is to make heading-to-id deterministic in our markdown linter. We can add a build-time transform that normalizes heading ids (or injects explicit ids for headings inside admonitions). but that might be scope creep.

lee: for immediate fix, can we update the config guide to add explicit ids on the affected headings and add a unit in docs/tests/link_snippets.test.md to cover this pattern?

hana: yes — i'll open a tiny PR that: 1) adds explicit {#using-custom-kernels} and {#advanced-caching} ids on the headings, 2) inserts a blank HTML comment before the code fence in the two spots, 3) updates contributor guide note about avoiding relying on implicit id generation inside admonitions.

build-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/5125 (admonition heading id mismatch on docusaurus)

docs-bot: Linkcheck report attached: https://ci.redwood/links/1749987654/report — 2 broken fragments.

phil: tiny nit: prefer HTML id on the heading rather than comment hack. the comment is okay short-term.

hana: got it. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302 — changes: explicit ids, one-line blank comment in two places, added two assertions in link_snippets.test.md. keeping it minimal.

docs-bot: CI linkcheck re-run: 0 broken fragments.

lee: can we add a short entry in CHANGELOG.docs about the fix, and a follow-up to consider a linter rule for future?

phil: added a ticket to the infra backlog to explore normalizing slug generation during build.

hana: thanks all. closing once merge completes.
